findings.title: APPROVED state with no hotel — stranded UX
findings.description: In hotel-review/page.tsx, when handleRefresh finds the application is APPROVED but getMyHotel() returns null, it sets a checkMessage string but renders no navigation button. The user sees 'Choose a subscription plan to activate your hotel' with no link to /dashboard/subscription.
findings.action: Add a 'Choose a plan' button in the APPROVED state that navigates to /dashboard/subscription when checkMessage is set and hotel is null.

findings.title: verifyPayment plan cast from metadata is unvalidated
findings.description: verifyPayment casts paystackData.data.metadata.plan directly to SubscriptionPlan and passes it to createSubscription, which immediately accesses SUBSCRIPTION_PLANS[dto.plan].priceNgn with no null guard. If the metadata field is absent or corrupt, the endpoint throws an unhandled TypeError (500) instead of a user-friendly error.
findings.action: Add: if (!SUBSCRIPTION_PLANS[planFromMeta]) throw new BadRequestException('Invalid plan received from payment gateway. Please contact support.') before calling createSubscription.
